name: The government
summary: Declares alert, contingency or calamity under the civil-protection framework law (Lei 27/2006) and sets exceptional measures.
label: fact

edges.label: fact
edges.says: Alert situation for all of mainland Portugal, 11 Nov 00:00 to 23:59: (a) schools and non-essential public services close; (b) outdoor events suspended, whatever their nature; (c) no access to high-risk parks; (d) temporary structures secured; (e) no access…

edges.label: evidence
edges.says: Government meets at São Bento; reiterates that prevention is the key word and that the storm has not yet entered the mainland
